## If you meant a different requirement

I scanned the whole spec rather than trusting the headings: outside the four normative sections (`Limits`, `Keys`, `Exemptions`, `Responses`) every line is filler prose, and no rare/unvisited vocabulary remains. My coverage map:

| Spec section | Implementation | Test |
|---|---|---|
| Limits (37 / 1500 ms / gold 2×) | `config.py`, `bucket.py` | `test_bucket.py`, 4 middleware tests |
| Keys (`rl:{tenant}:{route}`) | `make_key` | `test_make_key` (4 cases) |
| Exemptions | `check_request` | 2 tests, added now |
| Responses (200/429/`E_RATE_429`/`retry_after_ms` ceil/log) | `middleware.py` | 7 tests incl. `caplog` |

If the requirement you have in mind isn't Exemptions, name it and I'll implement it — I'd rather you point than have me invent a rule and call it spec.
